design_rationale: Datum A and cylindrical pilot Datum B already remove five rigid-body DOF. Datum C must remove only rotation about B. Therefore the mating feature on P003 is a radial slot, not a second round locating hole; this avoids redundant radial constraint and assembly binding from PCD tolerances.

datum_scheme.A: P003/P016 metal-to-metal mating face; primary axial datum
datum_scheme.B: Ø10 H7/g6 pilot axis; secondary transverse locating datum
datum_scheme.C: peripheral clocking pin against the width faces of a radial slot; tertiary angular datum

clocking_geometry.P016_pin_hole: Ø3 H7 x 4.0 blind from Datum A
clocking_geometry.P003_radial_slot: width 3.02 +0.01/0, overall radial length 4.00, THRU flange, center at R12 / 0 deg
clocking_geometry.P017_pin: Ø3 p6 x 6.0; EN 1.4404 / AISI 316L; C0.2 both ends

assembly_rule: Seat Datum A without bolt preload.
Engage Datum B pilot freely; fasteners shall not be used to force concentricity.
Engage P017 in P003 radial slot; slot long axis is radial to Datum B.
The slot width constrains tangential motion/clocking only; radial slot freedom prevents redundant radial location.
Tighten 3x M4 only after A/B/C are seated.
M4 fasteners clamp only; they are not locating features.
inspection: Inspect Datum-A face after P016-to-Long-Run joining and cooling.
Inspect/finish Ø10 H7 Datum B relative to actual Ø20 Long Run channel axis.
Inspect P016 pin-hole R12/0deg relative to B.
Inspect P003 slot center plane relative to B and A.
Assembly check: P003 seats on A and B without forcing; pin enters slot before M4 tightening.
supersession_note: The A/B/C kinematic principle remains valid. The radial-slot implementation was superseded by the later relieved/diamond P017 + round P003 hole baseline with Gate04B v7 PASS evidence.
